messages:
maria: Heads-up: onboarding customer Apex's LoRA into base v2.3. Did a quick smoke with AWQ 4-bit and saw a regression on invoice extraction (cents dropped). Posting short metrics and a failing example.

sam: Can you share the smoke numbers? Token-prob shift or decoding bias?

maria: Smoke pack summary:
- Perplexity delta (4bit vs fp16): +3.1
- Mean token logprob shift (digits): -1.05
- Exact match (amount with cents) on eval set (N=150): 88% -> 69%

Failing prompt:
```
Prompt:
"Please extract total: Invoice total USD 9,876.43."
FP16 -> "9,876.43"
AWQ4 -> "9,876.4"
```

tejas: Looks like quantized logits reducing trailing digit probability. Did you try softmerge/per-head float residuals like we did for other int4 regressions?

maria: Baseline run used AWQ config below (no softmerge):
```
quant: awq
bits: 4
block_size: 128
per_channel: true
```

sam: Repro tip: run the apex invoice evalpack with seed 42 to stabilize. Example: 
```
./scripts/run_quick_eval.sh --model merged/apex-lora-v2.3-awq4 --evalpack packs/apex-invoice-v2 --out out/apex-awq4.json --seed 42
```

ben: Customer impact is high  their payment routing needs exact cents. Dropping from ~88% to ~69% will cause misroutes. Can we test mitigations quickly?

tejas: Two quick parallel experiments: (A) softmerge with float residuals on last two decoder layers' numeric heads, residual_scale=0.015; (B) re-quant with block_size=32 and symmetric rounding. I expect (A) to be better.

sam: I can run both locally. Maria, can you put a tiny smoke subset (10 cases) and the merged tar somewhere?

maria: Uploaded subset: https://internal-storage.redwood/apex/invoice-smoke-10.json
Merged model tar: https://s3.redwood/models/apex/merged-v2.3-awq4.tar.gz

ci-bot: ci:quick-smoke kicked off for apex-lora-merged-v2.3-awq4 (job 8421). ETA ~10m. :rocket:

sam: Quick local results on subset (exact cents match):
- baseline awq4: 6/10
- softmerge (whitelist layers 10-11, residual_scale=0.015): 9/10
- awq4 block32 symmetric: 7/10

Log excerpt:
"Softmerge run -> metrics/exact_cents = 0.9; mean_digit_logprob_shift = -0.28"

tejas: Good signal. Softmerge reduces numeric token bias. Note: softmerge keeps small float overrides so expect ~4% token latency increase. We should quantify p95 delta.

maria: Request: deploy softmerge profile as 0.5% canary on Dedicated for 12h, measure exact_cents, token_latency, p95. If stable, recommend awq4-softmerge as the default for Apex merges. Also add an evalassert in apex-invoice pack: exact_cents >= 0.88.

sam: Canary config drafted: 
```
model: apex-lora-v2.3
quant_profile: awq4-softmerge
canary: true
traffic_pct: 0.5
monitor_metrics: [exact_cents, token_latency, p95_latency]
```
I'll land and watch telemetry.

ben: I'll prep CS messaging and give the customer an opt-in option for canary.

maria: Follow-ups: tejas -> short doc on softmerge params used (whitelist ['decoder.layers.10','decoder.layers.11'], residual_scale='0.015'); sam -> post 6h telemetry; ben -> CS note.

ci-bot: ci:quick-smoke (job 8421) passed.
